# Beau Monde Builders Palm Beach

> Custom home builder and renovation firm. Palm Beach office: 205 Worth Avenue, Suite 120, Palm Beach, FL 33480. Phone: (561) 646-8992. Email: aj@bmbpalmbeach.com. Headquarters: 1129 Rockledge Blvd, Suite 101, Rockledge, FL 32955. Parent site: https://www.bmb.builders/

AJ Hoover is a Florida Certified Master Builder, an NAHB Certified Master Building Professional, and a Florida Certified Building Contractor (CBC1260651), with 30 years in the construction industry. Beau Monde Builders was founded in 2015.

The site states 50+ reviews across Google, Houzz, Yelp, and more. It does not publish a star rating or a per-platform count.

## Services

- Custom home building
- Renovations: whole home, condominium, kitchen, and bath

## Service areas named on this site

- Palm Beach
- Palm Beach Island
- West Palm Beach
- Jupiter Island
- Singer Island
- Palm Beach County
